agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD clarified that massive multi-site housing is used only in central city sites for smaller family units, and noted it is conducting research on related problems outside of BREAKTHROUGH.
text:
Response: "Massive multiste housing" has been used only in central city sites for smaller family units, as discussed in the text.

HUD is well aware of the problems of such housing for families, and is conducting research on these problems outside of Operation BREAKTHROUGH.
